_about: ReleaseCfg.cs (lane laneRCHYGIENE, v100). Release switches the player reads at runtime. keepRunningInBackground=false: a normal player run pauses when the window loses focus (ProjectSettings runInBackground 0); true = never pause (dev machines). backgroundArgs: command-line flags that mark a proof / gate / capture run, which must keep running in the background (a name ending in ':' matches as a prefix; the harness flags in menu.json harnessArgs count too).
